title: US Midterm Election Day: Nasdaq +0.83%, Dow +0.47% as Markets Rally on GOP Senate Gains
summary: US stocks rallied on November 3 election day as Republicans headed toward a Senate majority. The Nasdaq rose 0.83%, the Dow gained 0.47%, and the Russell 2000 small-cap index surged roughly 3%, reflecting expectations of deregulation and tax cuts. AMD and tech names provided additional lift after AMD reported blowout Q3 earnings after the close.
why: 中期选举共和党参议院多数格局初定，市场对潜在减税及监管放松预期升温；小盘股大涨3%反映内需乐观情绪；叠加AMD财报强劲，半导体板块情绪全面回暖，短期看多逻辑占优。

title: Goldman Sachs: 60% of S&P 500 Stocks Already in Bear Market Despite Index Near Highs
summary: Goldman Sachs strategist Sina Molavi noted that roughly 60% of S&P 500 component stocks have already declined 20% or more from their individual peaks — meeting the technical definition of a bear market — even as the index itself remains near all-time highs. The divergence reflects narrow mega-cap leadership masking broad underlying market weakness.
why: 市值加权指数走强但多数成分股深陷熊市，市场宽度极度收窄；龙头股一旦走弱将触发快速补跌；对持仓中个股期权策略，建议在指数高位附近提高保护性头寸比例，警惕指数与个股表现背离。

title: Apple Q4 FY2026 Earnings: Revenue $114.5B (+12% YoY), EPS $2.10 Beats; December Gross Margin Guided 45–46%
summary: Apple reported fiscal Q4 FY2026 results with revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12% year-over-year and ahead of estimates. Adjusted EPS of $2.10 beat the consensus. Services revenue reached a new record. Management guided December quarter gross margin of 45–46%, in line with expectations.
why: Services收入再创纪录，12月季度毛利率指引稳健，苹果财报为科技板块情绪提供支撑；但当日股价因英伟达超越市值而承压；期权隐含波动率财报后将显著回落，可考虑卖出短期高IV策略。

title: AMD Q3 2026 Earnings: Revenue $13.4B (+45% YoY), Data Center $8.5B (+97% YoY), EPS $2.09 Beats Estimates
summary: AMD reported Q3 2026 revenue of $13.4 billion, up 45% year-over-year and beating the $12.9B consensus estimate. The Data Center segment reached $8.5 billion, up 97% year-over-year on strong AI GPU demand. Adjusted EPS of $2.09 beat the $1.84 estimate. AMD issued a strong Q4 outlook.
why: AMD数据中心AI GPU收入同比翻近一倍，直接分享英伟达赛道需求；财报超预期推动AMD盘后大涨，可能提振英伟达、博通等AI芯片产业链估值；高景气的AI算力投资周期支持持仓中NVDA/AMD相关多头逻辑。

title: Palantir Q3 2026 Earnings: Revenue $2.313B (+96% YoY), EPS $0.44 Beats; US Commercial Exceeds Government First Time; FY2026 Guidance Raised to $8.53B
summary: Palantir reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2.313 billion, nearly doubling year-over-year. Adjusted EPS was $0.44, beating the $0.37 consensus. For the first time, US commercial revenue surpassed US government revenue, signaling a business model inflection. The company raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $8.53 billion.
why: 美国商业收入首次超越政府业务，标志Palantir从政府AI服务商向企业AI平台的结构性转变，估值逻辑升档；营收同比翻倍且全年指引上调，支持持仓中PLTR做多逻辑；强劲财报预计推动股价大幅上涨，注意行权价上限调整需求。

title: 英伟达超越苹果重夺全球市值第一，股价单日涨约3%
summary: 苹果Q4财报公布后股价承压下跌，英伟达于11月3日美股交易日市值超越苹果，重新登顶全球市值第一。英伟达当日股价上涨约3%，这是英伟达年内第二次超越苹果。AMD强劲财报进一步提振AI芯片板块整体情绪。
why: 英伟达重夺市值第一进一步确认AI算力主题的市场定价优先级，叠加AMD同日财报超预期，AI半导体板块多头逻辑持续强化；对持仓中NVDA相关期权头寸，可考虑适当上调行权价上限。
